MCP returned a successful FCFF valuation for Amazoncom, Inc. in USD, with estimated value per share of 191.77 versus a market price of 266.32. The model assumes revenue growth of 11.98% for years 2-5, then fades toward terminal growth of 4.6%; the mapped growth anchor is Retail (General), United States, 2026, with confidence 0.544. Margins start from a next-year operating margin of 16.0% and converge toward a target operating margin of 13.85%. Reinvestment is modeled through sales-to-capital of 3.25x in years 1-5 and 3.6x in years 6-10, with terminal reinvestment rate of 47.76%. Cost of capital starts at 10.05% and moves to 9.63% in the terminal period, using a 4.6% risk-free rate and Damodaran mature-market ERP plus country risk premium data dated 2026-04-01. Terminal value is 3.405 trillion, with present value of terminal value of 823.48 billion; total present value of operating assets is 2.129 trillion. Caveats: Yahoo Finance data can be missing, stale, or insufficient, rates are shown in percent, sales-to-capital is a multiple, and valuation-service model/data version fields were null in the MCP JSON."}
